headline: 23 detained from Tejgaon College mosque over suspected militant links
summary: Police conducted the operation on Friday after Jumu'ah prayers, acting on secret intelligence regarding suspected extremist activities.
details: Police detained 23 individuals from a mosque at Tejgaon College on Indira Road in Dhaka. The operation took place on Friday, September 18, following Jumu'ah prayers while the group was holding a meeting.

headline_marked: Woman and daughter [[arrested for killing auto-rickshaw driver]] in Moulvibazar
headline: Woman and daughter arrested for killing auto-rickshaw driver in Moulvibazar
summary: The suspects, Asma Begum and her 18-year-old daughter, allegedly killed Abul Kalam and dumped his body in the Juri river.
details: A woman and her 18-year-old daughter were arrested in Moulvibazar for allegedly killing a 40-year-old CNG-run auto-rickshaw driver, Abul Kalam, and dumping his body into the Juri river.
Police recovered the victim's body from the river in the Jangirai area of Jaifarnagar union after locals spotted it floating.
An inquest found multiple hack wounds on Kalam's neck, and the body was sent to Moulvibazar 250-Bed Hospital for an autopsy.
The investigation revealed that Kalam had a relationship with Asma Begum, who owned the auto-rickshaw that Kalam drove on rent.
Police say Asma confessed to the killing during initial interrogation, and officers seized the machete used in the crime and the victim's phone.
The two suspects have been produced before a court in Moulvibazar to have their statements recorded under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
caption:
A woman and her daughter allegedly killed a man and dumped his body in a river in Moulvibazar.

A woman and her 18-year-old daughter were arrested in Moulvibazar for allegedly killing a 40-year-old CNG-run auto-rickshaw driver, Abul Kalam, and dumping his body into the Juri river.

Police recovered the victim's body from the river in the Jangirai area of Jaifarnagar union after locals spotted it floating.

An inquest found multiple hack wounds on Kalam's neck, and the body was sent to Moulvibazar 250-Bed Hospital for an autopsy.

The investigation revealed that Kalam had a relationship with Asma Begum, who owned the auto-rickshaw that Kalam drove on rent.

Police say Asma confessed to the killing during initial interrogation, and officers seized the machete used in the crime and the victim's phone.

The two suspects have been produced before a court in Moulvibazar to have their statements recorded under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
